name: splicing factor proline and glutamine rich

function.text: SFPQ encodes splicing factor, proline- and glutamine-rich. Annotated molecular activities include transcription cis-regulatory region binding and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in RNA splicing and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include PEComa, malignant; TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
